name: Eureka Forbes Ltd
tagline: A category-leading water-purifier/vacuum-cleaner turnaround under new PE ownership, with genuinely weak trailing returns and a real promoter-pledge risk to weigh against fast recent growth
business_overview: Eureka Forbes is India's market leader in water purifiers (Aquaguard, ~45% share) and vacuum cleaners (Forbes/Euroclean, ~60% share), plus a growing air-purification line. Following a change of promoter to Advent International (a PE firm), new CEO Pratik Pota (ex-Jubilant) has been executing an operational turnaround since roughly 2023.
fundamentals_narrative: Trailing return ratios remain genuinely weak (single-digit ROE/ROCE), reflecting the business's earlier troubled history before the Advent-led turnaround. But recent growth has been striking: YoY revenue growth of 60.93% and 5-year profit CAGR of 160%, consistent with a company scaling off a low, post-restructuring base under new professional management. The gap between weak trailing return ratios and strong recent growth is real and large — this is an early-stage turnaround, not yet a proven compounder.

verdict_headline: A genuine category-leader turnaround with real recent growth, tempered by weak trailing returns and a real promoter-pledge risk that hasn't yet resolved
verdict_reasoning: This fits the weak-trailing-plus-strong-recent-catalyst pattern this project applies to mid-caps: single-digit trailing ROE/ROCE from the pre-turnaround era, now followed by genuinely strong recent growth (60.93% YoY revenue, 160% 5-yr profit CAGR) under new professional management with real category-leadership fundamentals (45%/60% market shares).

The trusted signal (harsh.beria93 disclosing a direct investment citing category leadership) is real, though the dedicated company thread itself is thin and doesn't yet show sustained multi-quarter diligence.

The promoter pledge (~54% of equity) is a genuine, disclosed risk that should not be waved away even though it's explained as typical PE-sponsor behavior — it remains a real balance-sheet vulnerability while outstanding, and the promoter has also been reducing its stake over time.

Given the real turnaround signal balanced against still-weak trailing profitability, thin community coverage, and an unresolved pledge risk, conviction is set to Low with thesis_fit '10x-in-2-3-years' carrying an explicit unconfirmed caveat — revisit once ROE/ROCE show sustained improvement and the pledge situation is clarified.
